headlines.text: Turning the clock back to 2024: Swerve Strickland vs. Claudio Castagnoli clashed for the AEW World Heavyweight Title, appearing on Collision, rated 8.08 ? a hard-hitting, high-quality battle. In a surprise open challenge on his first Collision as champion, Strickland survived a 21-minute war and hit the House Call to retain the AEW World Title against Castagnoli, the two shaking hands afterward.

Looking back to 2022, when it was title-change night for the AEW TNT Title as Scorpio Sky vs. Sammy Guevara battled it out in a Ladder match, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.55 ? ending the champion's reign at 1 defense. A wild, barbed-wire-laden ladder war in Philadelphia ? real ECW homage, real risk from both men, capped by Sky narrowly beating Guevara to the top of the ladder to reclaim the title for a second time.

Back on this day in 2024, The Beast Mortos arrived in AEW against Rey Fenix, appearing on Collision, rated 7.76 ? a well-worked match. The Beast Mortos made his AEW debut against a returning Rey Fenix, immediately impressing fans in a showcase for the promotion's newest signing.
